name: signet
description: Signet — AI-native Trusted Display Runtime. A browser extension that turns machine-readable content provenance (C2PA, signatures, hashes, AI labels) into a calm, human-trustworthy display layer.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm --filter @signet/demo typecheck && pnpm --filter @signet/extension typecheck
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check
